title: LibreCAD master PR #3269 regressions linked to upstream libdxfrw
scope: Overlay this libdxfrw checkout into a clean LibreCAD master checkout and run the merged PR #3269 named-LTYPE regression cases against the upstream library. This is a focused integration probe, not a clean full LibreCAD test build or platform/ABI qualification.

environment.testHarness: single-translation-unit Catch2 target in disposable clean consumer checkout

implementation.issue: LibreCAD's test translation units import DRW names and define a helper named dxfBlockRecord, colliding with the upstream global namespace dxfBlockRecord.
implementation.change: Move the private BLOCK_RECORD decoder to DRW::internal::DxfBlockRecordDecoder and update its upstream call sites.
implementation.followupControls: Correct two stale direct-control vectors: classify an unexpected pre-XDATA group-102 application marker as Application, and use unsupported group 1006 (rather than supported XDATA handle group 1005) for the Unexpected-code case.

commands: build/upstream-fast/pr3269_upstream_link_tests 'DXF writes a changed line type definition over its record'
build/upstream-fast/pr3269_upstream_link_tests 'DWG writes a changed line type definition over its record'
build/upstream-fast/pr3269_upstream_link_tests 'DXF writes a redefined built-in from the table'

caseResults.case: DXF writes a changed line type definition over its record
DWG writes a changed line type definition over its record
caseResults.diagnostic: DWG low-level write fails with error 2 at dwg-header-handseed finalization; the forwarded $DIMSTYLE header value has integer variant type although DXF group 2 requires a string.

caseResults.case: DXF writes a redefined built-in from the table
DXF writes a changed complex line type without its segments
caseResults.diagnostic: DXF output fails during OBJECTS emission. The local test input includes an unrelated MLINESTYLE referencing VENDOR_MLS without a corresponding LTYPE table entry; isolate or close that dependency before attributing the failure to PR #3269.

caseResults.case: DXF writes a twin archived spelling as it came beside a changed record

namedLTypeSelector.note: The selector includes older LibreCAD expectations outside the five PR #3269 regressions; the aggregate failures are not all attributable to the merged PR.

result.fullConsumerFastTarget: NOT BUILT: unrelated LibreCAD test translation units fail against upstream headers/types (including dxf_object_tests.cpp and entity_metadata_tests.cpp); the disposable single-TU PR regression target compiles and links successfully.

fixturePolicy.generatedTestData: The consumer tests generate temporary files and remove them. No repository fixture files were added or changed.

limitations: The clean LibreCAD fast-test target links its bundled libdxfrw; the upstream overlay was tested with a temporary focused target.
Only three of the five merged PR #3269 regression cases pass with this upstream checkout; the two failures need isolated investigation and resolution before P8-D can close.
The DWG failure is currently traced to a wrong-typed HEADER variable; no coercion was added because it would weaken strict output validation.
The complex-LTYPE failure is entangled with an unrelated MLINESTYLE-to-LTYPE dependency in the test input.
LibreCAD_3 clean linked tests, ABI comparison, Linux/Windows qualification, and native application behavior remain unqualified.
